text:
Priya: Heads-up — starting the migration of org-level roles to scoped roles next week. Goal: move to per-route and per-tenant scopes without breaking existing quotas and service accounts.

Sam: Important Q — how do we map quotas? We must ensure per-route quotas don't get double-counted when a role becomes multiple scoped bindings.

Maya: Plan: create a mapping table: org_role -> [tenant_admin, route:*/read, route:/models/*/invoke]. Service accounts need explicit migration rules.

Alex: SRE notes: telemetry will need new fields (old_role, new_role, migration_batch) and a reconcile job to compare pre/post request rates. Also watch 403 spikes.

Jordan: UX — console should have a "Migration preview" that shows a diff and a per-tenant impact estimate. Canary toggle: opt-in for 5% of tenants.

Priya: Proposed internal API:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/v1/roles/migrate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"batch_id":"b-2026-03-28","criteria":{"created_before":"2024-01-01"},"dry_run":true}'
```

Sam: Make sure the job is idempotent and emits a migration_id per tenant. We should also store a rollback plan per migration_id.

Maya: Test plan highlights (will add full matrix in the ticket):

- service-account tokens: ensure scopes are preserved
- delegated admin: ensure no privilege escalation
- quota enforcement: compare pre/post token counts
- routing-affinity: model-invoke routes keep original affinity

Alex: Telemetry dashboard items:
- migration_batch KPI (success rate)
- 403/401 delta by tenant
- throttle rate per route
- latency P95 pre/post

Sam: Implementation note: evaluation order change — explicit route scopes should be applied before tenant-wide grants to avoid accidental elevation.

Jordan: UX sketch: show side-by-side "Before -> After" permissions with counts and a short explanation line: "This change scopes broad role X to specific route access".

Priya: Rollout proposal: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%, gate on: 403 delta < 0.1%, P95 latency change < 5%, quota mismatch < 0.5%.

Maya: I'll add the detailed test matrix and will run dry-run for first 100 tenants. :thumbsup:

Alex: I'll build the telemetry panels and add alerts for sudden 403 spikes.

deploy-bot: migration job "b-2026-03-28" scheduled (dry_run)

Priya: Thanks — will open PRs for migration job + console preview. Tagging @Maya @Alex for follow-ups.
